claims.claim: OpenAI announced dots, always-on AI agents that run on dedicated cloud computers and connect to over 4,000 applications.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI announced a new kind of AI helper called dots that stays active even when you are not chatting with it. Instead of waiting for your next message like a regular chatbot, a dot runs on its own cloud computer and keeps working toward goals you set.
claims.source_title: OpenAI launches Always-on AI agents in ChatGPT Under Dots Project
claims.supporting_quote: Each dot runs on OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra model and is assigned its own cloud computer and browser. Through OpenAI’s plugin ecosystem, it can connect to more than 4,000 applications.
